title: Frame a window, tie in a wall corner and add exterior trim
applicability: Use for a brick wall with a defined opening and an exterior facing. Choose the frame and pane by compatible fitting and the wall studs by the desired trim depth and direction.
steps: Start by reserving two studs by three bricks for the 60593 frame. Lay a sill and a corner return that ties the side wall into the front. Let the side piers set the lintel height and plan the joint in each brick course.

Fit the 60602 pane_tab to frame_slot, span the opening with the 3710 header and use the visible side studs of the 11211 in the right pier for trim. Build the trim as a separate finish so it can change without rebuilding the opening.

Check that the pane and trim are both engaged, the frame is supported at the sill, and the trim stays outside the wall plane. For a wider opening, measure the bearing on each side before extending the lintel.
expected: The pane connects to the frame and the exterior trim stays forward of the wall plane. The sill, return, piers, frame and header belong to a valid single component.

sources.author: Carlos Antelo
